Criteria for Approval: Diagnosis of hepatitis B virus infection; AND

Prescribed by, or in consultation with, a hepatology/
gastroenterology, infectious disease, transplant or other
appropriate specialist; AND

Patient does NOT have decompensated cirrhosis (Child-Pugh B
or C); AND

Trial and failure of, intolerance, or contraindication to, entecavir
or (tenofovir disoproxil fumarate); AND

NOT concurrently taking any P-gp inducers (e.g., oxcarbazepine,
phenobarbital, phenytoin, rifabutin, rifampin, rifapentine, or St.
John’s wort); AND
If HIV-1 positive, NOT using Vemlidy as monotherapy.

Age Limit: ≥ 6 years and weight ≥ 25 kg
Quantity Limit: 1 per day (allow 2 per day for drug interactions)
